_comment: Connection exhaustion from idle-in-transaction connections holding pool slots and row locks (no replica lag). The fix is to terminate the stuck connections, NOT a failover - which is why Signals.stuck_connections is checked before the replica/pool branch, and is guarded by replica_lag<=10 so a genuine replica-lag incident (inc-003) still routes to failover.
